sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 阅读关于家庭理财的内容；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn about the history of money;

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: describe our shopping habits and money management;
sentences.ipa: /dɪˈskraɪb ˌaʊə ˈʃɒpɪŋ ˈhæbɪts ænd ˈmʌniː ˈmænɪdʒmənt;/
sentences.meaning: 描述我们的购物习惯和理财方式；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: understand how to manage money well.
sentences.meaning: 懂得如何妥善管理钱财。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Money plays an important role in our lives.
sentences.ipa: /ˈmʌniː ˈpleɪz ən ɪˈmpɔːtənt ˈrəʊl ɪn ˌaʊə ˈlaɪvz./
sentences.meaning: 金钱对我们的生活起着重要作用。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s learn about money and how to manage it well.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlets ˈlɜːn əˈbaʊt ˈmʌniː ænd ˌhaʊ tə ˈmænɪdʒ ɪt ˈwel./
sentences.meaning: 让我们了解金钱，并学习如何合理管理金钱。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A The Class 1, Grade 7 students are learning about money around the world.
sentences.ipa: /ə ðə ˈklɑːs ˈwʌn, ˈgreɪd ˈsevən ˈstjuːdnts ɑː ˈlɜːnɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈmʌniː əˈraʊnd ðə ˈwɜːld./
sentences.meaning: 一年级7年级的学生在世界各地学习钱学问。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Match each country and its money with the correct gift.
sentences.ipa: /ˈmætʃ ˈiːtʃ ˈkʌntriː ænd ɪts ˈmʌniː wɪð ðə kəˈrekt ˈgɪft./
sentences.meaning: 将每个国家及其资金与正确的天赋相匹配。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and talk about popular gifts from different countries.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwɜːk ɪn ˈpeəz ænd ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˈpɒpjʊlə ˈgɪfts frɒm ˈdɪfərənt ˈkʌntriːz./
sentences.meaning: 成对地工作，谈论不同国家的流行礼物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Simon and Millie are talking about the gifts above.
sentences.ipa: /ˈbiː saɪmən ænd ˈmɪliː ɑː ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈgɪfts əˈbʌv./
sentences.meaning: B赛门和米莉在谈论上面的礼物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /ˈjuːz ðə ˌkɒnvəˈseɪʃən bɪˈləʊ æz ə ˈmɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Which gift do you like, Millie?

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢那些俄罗斯娃娃。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: They’re a set of dolls in different sizes. Usually they come one inside another, from the biggest to the smallest. They’re colourful and full of surprises. What about you, Simon?
sentences.ipa: /ˌðeə ə ˈset ɒv ˈdɒlz ɪn ˈdɪfərənt ˈsaɪzɪz. ˈjuːʒʊəliː ðeɪ ˈkʌm ˈwʌn ˌɪˈnsaɪd əˈnʌðə, frɒm ðə ˈbɪgɪst tə ðə ˈsmɔːlɪst. ˌðeə ˈkʌləfʊl ænd ˈfʊl ɒv səˈpraɪzɪz. ˌwɒt əˈbaʊt juː, saɪmən?/
sentences.meaning: 它们是一套大小不一的娃娃。 通常它们从最大的到最小的，它们相互内在。它们色彩鲜艳，充满惊喜。你呢，西蒙？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I love baseball caps. Players wear them to protect their eyes from the sun, and they’re also a kind of fashion.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈlʌv ˈbeɪsbɔːl ˈkæps. ˈpleɪəz ˈweə ˌðem tə prəˈtekt ðeə ˈaɪz frɒm ðə ˈsʌn, ænd ðeə ˈɔːlsəʊ ə ˈkaɪnd ɒv ˈfæʃən./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢棒球帽，玩家戴着棒球帽是为了保护眼睛免受太阳的侵袭，他们也是时尚的一种。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C What other countries’ money do you know?
sentences.ipa: /ˈsiː ˌwɒt ˈʌðə ˈkʌntriːz” ˈmʌniː ˈduː juː ˈnəʊ?/
sentences.meaning: C. 其他国家有哪些钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon is talking to his mum about how his family manages their money.
sentences.ipa: /saɪmən ɪz ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə hɪz ˈmʌm əˈbaʊt ˌhaʊ hɪz ˈfæmɪliː ˈmænɪdʒɪz ðeə ˈmʌniː./
sentences.meaning: 西蒙在和他妈妈说他的家人怎么管理他们的钱

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪˈfɔː ˈriːdɪŋ, ˈθɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkwestʃənz bɪˈləʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Does your family make plans for using money?
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈdʌz jɔː ˈfæmɪliː ˌmeɪk ˈplænz fɔː ˈjuːzɪŋ ˈmʌniː?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What do you think your family spends the most money on every year?
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌwɒt ˈduː juː ˈθɪŋk jɔː ˈfæmɪliː ˈspendz ðə ˈməʊst ˈmʌniː ˌɒn ˈevəriː ˈjɪə?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你认为你的家人每年花的钱最多吗？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: There’s a new mall across the street. Let’s go shopping.
sentences.ipa: /ˌðeəz ə ˈnjuː ˈmæl əˈkrɒs ðə ˈstriːt. ˈlets ˌgəʊ ˈʃɒpɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 街对面有个新的购物中心。我们去购物吧。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: OK. Can I have a new pair of sports shoes?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊˈkeɪ. ˌkæn ˌaɪ hæv ə ˈnjuː ˈpeə ɒv ˈspɔːts ˈʃuːz?/
sentences.meaning: 好，我可以换双运动鞋吗？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Of course. And we also need a new computer.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒv ˈkɔːs. ˌænd wiː ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈniːd ə ˈnjuː kəˈmpjuːtə./
sentences.meaning: 当然，我们还需要一台新的电脑。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: That will cost a lot of money.
sentences.ipa: /ˈðæt wɪl ˈkɒst ə ˈlɒt ɒv ˈmʌniː./

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Don’t worry. Your dad and I manage money well. We make a budget every year.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdəʊnt ˈwʌriː. ˌjɔː ˈdæd ænd ˌaɪ ˈmænɪdʒ ˈmʌniː ˈwel. ˌwiː ˌmeɪk ə ˈbʌdʒɪt ˈevəriː ˈjɪə./
sentences.meaning: 别担心，你老爸和我钱管理得很好，我们每年都做一个预算。

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Well … we need to cover your education first. Then we have to pay for our flat, car, food and other daily needs every month. All these cost about 50 per cent of our budget.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwel … wiː ˈniːd tə ˈkʌvə jɔː ˌedjʊˈkeɪʃən ˈfɜːst. ˈðen wiː hæv tə ˈpeɪ fɔː ˌaʊə ˈflæt, ˈkɑː, ˈfuːd ænd ˈʌðə ˈdeɪliː ˈniːdz ˈevəriː ˈmʌnθ. ˈɔːl ðiːz ˈkɒst əˈbaʊt ˈfɪftiː pɜː ˈsent ɒv ˌaʊə ˈbʌdʒɪt./
sentences.meaning: 我们每月必须支付我们的公寓、汽车、食品和其他日常需求，所有这些费用大约占我们预算的50%。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Where does the other half go?

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: We spend about 30 per cent on special things.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈspend əˈbaʊt ˈθɜːtiː pɜː ˈsent ˌɒn ˈspeʃl ˈθɪŋz./
sentences.meaning: 我们花费大约30%用于特殊事务。

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Like taking holidays. Holidays can be expensive.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlaɪk ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈhɒlɪdeɪz. ˈhɒlɪdeɪz kæn biː ɪˈkspensɪv./
sentences.meaning: 比如休假 假期可能很贵的

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Of course. We leave about 20 per cent in our bank account. It’s a good idea to save for a rainy day.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒv ˈkɔːs. ˌwiː ˈliːv əˈbaʊt ˈtwentiː pɜː ˈsent ɪn ˌaʊə ˈbæŋk əˈkaʊnt. ˌɪts ə ˈgʊd aɪˈdɪə tə ˈseɪv fɔː ə ˈreɪniː ˈdeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 当然，我们把20%左右的存款留在我们的银行账户里。 节省一个下雨日是好主意。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Label the parts of the chart about his family budget, and write the correct percentage next to each label.
sentences.ipa: /ˈleɪbəl ðə ˈpɑːts ɒv ðə ˈtʃɑːt əˈbaʊt hɪz ˈfæmɪliː ˈbʌdʒɪt, ænd ˈraɪt ðə kəˈrekt pəˈsentɪdʒ ˈnekst tʊ ˈiːtʃ ˈleɪbəl./
sentences.meaning: 标注图表中有关他家庭预算的部分，并在每个标签旁边写出正确的百分比。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Here is a pie chart about Simon’s family budget.
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈhɪə ɪz ə ˈpaɪ ˈtʃɑːt əˈbaʊt saɪmən s ˈfæmɪliː ˈbʌdʒɪt./
sentences.meaning: 以下是关于西蒙家庭预算的馅饼图。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then fill in the details in the chart.
sentences.ipa: /ˈðen ˈfɪl ˈɪn ðə ˈdiːteɪlz ɪn ðə ˈtʃɑːt./
sentences.meaning: 然后填写图表中的细节。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Read the conversation again and answer the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /ˈbiː ˈriːd ðə ˌkɒnvəˈseɪʃən əˈgen ænd ˈɑːnsə ðə ˈkwestʃənz bɪˈləʊ./
sentences.meaning: B再读一次谈话，回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What does Simon’s mum need to buy in the new mall?
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˌwɒt ˈdʌz saɪmən s ˈmʌm ˈniːd tə ˈbaɪ ɪn ðə ˈnjuː ˈmæl?/
sentences.meaning: 1 Simon的妈妈在新商场需要买什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 How does Simon’s family manage their money?
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌhaʊ ˈdʌz saɪmən s ˈfæmɪliː ˈmænɪdʒ ðeə ˈmʌniː?/
sentences.meaning: 2 Simon的家人如何管理他们的钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 What comes first in Simon’s family budget?
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˌwɒt ˈkʌmz ˈfɜːst ˈɪn saɪmən s ˈfæmɪliː ˈbʌdʒɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 3 西蒙的家庭预算排名第一的是什么呢？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 What is an example of a special thing in Simon’s family?
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ˌwɒt ɪz ən ɪˈgzɑːmpəl ɒv ə ˈspeʃl ˈθɪŋ ˈɪn saɪmən s ˈfæmɪliː?/
sentences.meaning: 4 西蒙家有什么特殊之处？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 What does Simon’s mum mean by saying “to save for a rainy day”?
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv ˌwɒt ˈdʌz saɪmən s ˈmʌm ˈmiːn baɪ ˈseɪɪŋ “tə ˈseɪv fɔː ə ˈreɪniː ˈdeɪ”?/
sentences.meaning: 5 Simon的妈妈说“为雨天省钱”是什么意思？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete the blog post with the correct forms of the words and phrases in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəˈmpliːt ðə ˈblɒg ˈpəʊst wɪð ðə kəˈrekt ˈfɔːmz ɒv ðə ˈwɜːdz ænd ˈfreɪzɪz ɪn ðə ˈbɒks bɪˈləʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在博客文章中填写以下框中文字和短语的正确形式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Simon is reading his friend John’s blog post about his family budget.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsiː saɪmən ɪz ˈriːdɪŋ hɪz ˈfrend ˈdʒɒnz ˈblɒg ˈpəʊst əˈbaʊt hɪz ˈfæmɪliː ˈbʌdʒɪt./
sentences.meaning: C Simon 正在阅读朋友 John 写的关于家庭预算的博客文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 金钱在每一个家庭都很重要。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 这些东西可能是非常的。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: things like our house and car.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But my parents always have enough money because they keep to their
sentences.ipa: /ˌbʌt maɪ ˈpeərənts ˈɔːlweɪz hæv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌniː bɪˈkɒz ðeɪ ˈkiːp tə ðeə/
sentences.meaning: 但我的父母总是有足够的钱 因为他们坚持自己的

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: leave about 15 of their money in the bank for “a rainy
sentences.ipa: /ˈliːv əˈbaʊt ˌfɪˈftiːn ɒv ðeə ˈmʌniː ɪn ðə ˈbæŋk fɔː “ə ˈreɪniː/
sentences.meaning: 把他们的15笔钱留在银行里，以便“下雨”。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I think that is a great idea.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈðæt ɪz ə ˈgreɪt aɪˈdɪə./
sentences.meaning: 我认为这是一个好主意。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: When I have money, I usually ask my
sentences.ipa: /ˌwen ˌaɪ hæv ˈmʌniː, ˌaɪ ˈjuːʒʊəliː ˈɑːsk ˈmaɪ/
sentences.meaning: 当我有钱的时候，我通常问我的

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: mum to help me put some in the.
sentences.ipa: /ˈmʌm tə ˈhelp ˌmiː ˌpʊt ˌsʌm ɪn ðə./

sentences.text: D Think about the questions below.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Share your answers with your classmates.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What do you think of Simon’s family budget?
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˌwɒt ˈduː juː ˈθɪŋk ɒv saɪmən s ˈfæmɪliː ˈbʌdʒɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 1你觉得西蒙的家庭预算怎么样？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Make a budget for your family.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌmeɪk ə ˈbʌdʒɪt fɔː jɔː ˈfæmɪliː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Do you think it is important to make a budget?
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈduː juː ˈθɪŋk ɪt ɪz ɪˈmpɔːtənt tə ˌmeɪk ə ˈbʌdʒɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: A 使用一些/任何数据

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon is talking to his mum before they go to the supermarket.
sentences.ipa: /saɪmən ɪz ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə hɪz ˈmʌm bɪˈfɔː ðeɪ ˌgəʊ tə ðə ˈsuːpəˌmɑːkɪt./
sentences.meaning: 在他们去超市之前 Simon正在和他妈妈说话

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Let’s go to the supermarket. We need some meat,... and also some fruit and vegetables.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlets ˌgəʊ tə ðə ˈsuːpəˌmɑːkɪt. ˌwiː ˈniːd ˌsʌm ˈmiːt,... ænd ˈɔːlsəʊ ˌsʌm ˈfruːt ænd ˈvedʒɪtəbəlz./
sentences.meaning: 让我们去超市吧，我们需要一些肉，还有水果和蔬菜。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We can use some in questions when we are making offers or requests.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː kæn ˈjuːz ˌsʌm ɪn ˈkwestʃənz ˌwen wiː ɑː ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈɒfəz ɔː rɪˈkwests./
sentences.meaning: 当我们提出要约或请求时，我们可以在问题中使用一些。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use it when we expect the answer to be “yes”.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈjuːz ɪt ˌwen wiː ɪˈkspekt ðiː ˈɑːnsə tə biː “ˈjes”./
sentences.meaning: 当我们期望答案是“是”时，我们就使用它。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: OK, Mum. Please buy some bananas. They’re my favourite.
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊˈkeɪ, ˈmʌm. ˈpliːz ˈbaɪ ˌsʌm bəˈnɑːnəz. ˌðeə maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt./
sentences.meaning: 好的妈妈请买些香蕉这是我最喜欢的

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: OK. Do we need any other things?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊˈkeɪ. ˈduː wiː ˈniːd ˈeniː ˈʌðə ˈθɪŋz?/
sentences.meaning: 好，我们还需要其他东西吗？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: We don’t have any drinks. Can we buy some, Mum?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈdəʊnt hæv ˈeniː ˈdrɪŋks. ˌkæn wiː ˈbaɪ ˌsʌm, ˈmʌm?/
sentences.meaning: 我们没有喝的，我们能买点吗，妈妈？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use some or any to talk about the amount of something.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈjuːz ˌsʌm ɔː ˈeniː tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ðiː əˈmaʊnt ɒv ˈsʌmθɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我们用一些或任何 谈论的东西的数量。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We often use (some, any) in positive sentences.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈɒfən ˈjuːz (ˌsʌm, ˈeniː) ɪn ˈpɒzɪtɪv ˈsentənsɪz./
sentences.meaning: 我们经常在正面的句子中使用(某些，任何)。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We often use (some, any) in negative sentences
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈɒfən ˈjuːz (ˌsʌm, ˈeniː) ɪn ˈnegətɪv ˈsentənsɪz/
sentences.meaning: 我们经常用(一些，任何)负面的句子
